case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment heading.

number_of_accused.reason: Judgment states there are eleven appellants.

accused_gender.reason: Judgment never states accused genders; 'Mixed' implies female accused not mentioned anywhere.

accused_age.reason: No accused ages are stated in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of accused is not stated.

accused_caste.correct_value: Tribal (Santhal community); caste category not stated
accused_caste.quote: The appellants as well as the material witnesses belong to Santhal community. They are tribals.
accused_caste.reason: Judgment describes accused as Santhal tribals; it never says Scheduled Caste.

accused_occupation.reason: Occupation is not stated; judgment only notes very poor economic status.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Judgment describes the appellants as poor tribals.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: Victim Jhore Soren is male (husband of two wives).

victim_caste.reason: Victim caste is not expressly stated.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Fellow villagers of the same Santhal community (village Mobarakpur) with inimical relations
accused_victim_relationship.quote: The appellants and the prosecution witnesses belong to Santhal Community of village Mobarakpur.
accused_victim_relationship.reason: 'Neighbour' is not stated; judgment only says same village and community with inimical relations.

offence_category.correct_value: Murder (as charged); finally culpable homicide not amounting to murder
offence_category.reason: Charged as murder, but the final conviction was culpable homicide, which the value omits.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC s.148; s.302 r/w s.149 (set aside); s.304 Part II (final conviction)
statutory_provisions.quote: offences punishable under Section 148 and Section 302 read with Section 149 of the IPC
statutory_provisions.reason: Omits s.148 and the final s.304 Part II conviction.

weapon.reason: Judgment states appellants were armed with lathis and tangies.

evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness testimony and medical (post-mortem) evidence are relied upon.

confession.reason: No confession is mentioned; accused denied the prosecution case.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: No aggravating circumstances are identified in the judgment.

mitigating_circumstances.correct_value: Poor tribal status, trivial triggering incident, and almost 14 years already in jail
mitigating_circumstances.quote: we are informed that the appellants are in jail for almost 14 years
mitigating_circumstances.reason: Court expressly relied on poverty, trivial cause, and long custody as mitigating factors.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court convicted under s.148 and s.302 r/w s.149 and imposed life imprisonment.

high_court_outcome.correct_value: Appeal dismissed; High Court affirmed conviction and sentence
high_court_outcome.quote: The appellants' appeal was dismissed by the High Court.
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court outcome was affirmance, not 'Not applicable'.

final_outcome.reason: Appellants remained convicted, with the offence reduced to s.304 Part II.

offence_finally_established.reason: Court convicted for culpable homicide not amounting to murder.

imprisonment_type.correct_value: Sentence of period already undergone (time served) under s.304 Part II; no fresh term specified
imprisonment_type.quote: the sentence already undergone by them is directed to be treated as sentence imposed on them under Section 304 Part II
imprisonment_type.reason: Sentence is time already served, not a specified fixed term; the label is only loosely right.

imprisonment_years.correct_value: Not stated as sentence term; appellants had been in jail almost 14 years
imprisonment_years.quote: the appellants are in jail for almost 14 years
imprisonment_years.reason: Judgment says 'almost 14 years' custody, and sentence is time already undergone, not a stated 14-year term.

neutral_facts.reason: Facts are consistent with the judgment and do not state the court's final outcome.

offence_severity.reason: A 10-year minimum is not in the judgment; only life imprisonment as trial sentence appears.

attempt_completion.reason: Assault resulted in the victim's death, so the offence is completed.

physical_harm.reason: Judgment notes fourteen injuries, mostly bruises and abrasions, two rib fractures and haematoma.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Single homicide; each accused charged under s.148 and s.302 r/w s.149; final conviction under s.304 Part II
number_of_offences.quote: convicted for offences punishable under Section 148 and Section 302 read with Section 149 of the IPC
number_of_offences.reason: Eleven accused, not eleven offences; s.304 Part II conviction was substituted, not upheld.

financial_property_loss.correct_value: Not stated as a financial loss claim; theft of one hen and penalty of hen plus two handies of liquor in background
financial_property_loss.quote: He was ordered to give a hen to appellant-B and, in addition, he had to give two handies of liquor.
financial_property_loss.reason: Stolen hen and liquor penalty are property matters in the background, so 'Not applicable' is incomplete.

premeditation_planning.correct_value: No common object to murder found; but the accused called the victim to a meeting on a pretext
premeditation_planning.quote: On the next day, in the morning, deceased-Jhore Soren and PW-7 Kanka were called to the courtyard of one Saheb Hasda on the pretext that a meeting was to be held
premeditation_planning.reason: Court found no common object to murder, but pretextual summoning is omitted from the value.

motive.quote: their anger and reaction to the theft of hen must be viewed against the background of their economic and social status
motive.reason: Motive is anger over the hen theft and the panchayat penalty.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Accurately reflects the court's acceptance of PW-1, PW-3, PW-6, PW-7 and PW-9.

witness_credibility.reason: Matches the court's findings on relationship and ring of truth.

post_offence_conduct.reason: Accused's post-offence conduct is not stated; PW-7's flight is not accused conduct.

custody_duration.quote: the appellants are in jail for almost 14 years
custody_duration.reason: Judgment says 'almost 14 years', not exactly 14 years.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence: 15/4/1989 (day after the 14/4/1989 incident); trial judgment date not stated; High Court judgment: 20.01.2003; Supreme Court: 05.02.2014
trial_duration.quote: On the next day, in the morning, deceased-Jhore Soren and PW-7 Kanka were called
trial_duration.reason: 14/4/1989 was the earlier incident; 20.01.2003 is the High Court order, not the trial judgment.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names match the judgment's appearance listing.

investigation_status.correct_value: Investigation completed and appellants charged; charge sheet filing and trial completion implied, not expressly stated
investigation_status.quote: upon completion of the investigation, the appellants came to be charged as aforesaid
investigation_status.reason: Charge sheet filing is not expressly stated, though investigation completion and charging are.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural irregularity is noted in the judgment.

appeal_history.reason: Trial, High Court and Supreme Court outcomes are accurately described.

prosecution_argument.reason: Matches the State's argument on common object and truthful eyewitnesses.

defence_argument.correct_value: Prosecution failed to prove case beyond reasonable doubt; no intent to kill as injuries superficial and lathis used; appellants poor tribals long in jail
defence_argument.quote: the prosecution has failed to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt
defence_argument.reason: Individual-role and fatal-weapon arguments are not attributed to the defence; intent and superficial-injury points are omitted.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Reflects the court's reasoning on common object, individual role and ends of justice.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: Listed authorities match those the judgment relies on.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Rationale matches court's ends-of-justice reasoning on background, trivial incident and custody.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Lists the mitigating factors the court relied on.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: No aggravating factors are identified by the court.

other_sentence_order.reason: Matches the order to treat time served as s.304 Part II sentence and release forthwith.
